backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing taxi pickup logging with user profiles, access control, storage mixins, and data models for pickups, customers, reports, and import/export.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requests to affected frontend files and components with associated test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component handling identity initialization, actor setup, profile loading, and main app routing.
frontend/src/components/AboutDialog.tsx: Modal dialog showing app information, copyright, and contact details with styled opaque content.
frontend/src/components/ActorInitializat: Gate component that manages backend actor initialization states with loading, ready, and diagnostic error handling flows.
frontend/src/components/CustomerLookup.t: Customer selection combobox using popover and command UI to search, select, or clear customer entries with suggestion fetching.
frontend/src/components/CycleBalanceDial: Dialog that displays the current canister cycle balance with refresh functionality.
frontend/src/components/DailyReportDialo: Dialog for selecting a date range and viewing filtered, sorted daily financial totals.
frontend/src/components/DeleteAllRecords: Confirmation dialog that triggers deletion of all stored records via mutation.
frontend/src/components/DeleteDraftDataD: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/EditDeleteRecord: Dialog to select, edit, or delete recent pickup records with validation and backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Dialog allowing drivers to edit and save profile information using backend update logic.
frontend/src/components/ExportImportDial: Dialog for exporting data to JSON and importing normalized data files with error handling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/GeneratePDFDialo: Dialog component that triggers generating a static HTML PDF specification document.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main header with menus, theme toggle, identity actions, and controls for opening various app dialogs.
frontend/src/components/PickupForm.tsx: Form for entering and validating pickup details, autofilling customer info, and submitting records.
frontend/src/components/PickupList.tsx: Displays pickups for a selected date with sorting, error/loading states, and daily totals.
frontend/src/components/TimePicker12h.ts: 12‑hour time picker using dropdowns for hour, minute, and AM/PM selection.
frontend/src/docs/manual-qa-android-chro: Manual QA checklist for verifying overlay, popover, and dialog opacity behavior in Android Chrome.
frontend/src/docs/manual-qa-edit-delete-: QA checklist for verifying scrolling, overlays, and transitions in the Edit/Delete Record dialog on Android Chrome.
frontend/src/docs/manual-qa-version-103-: Regression QA checklist confirming creation, listing, editing, deletion, and reporting features work after the v103 issue.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor using react-query and refreshes dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Wrapper hook exposing actor readiness and status from useBackendActor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.tsx: Empty placeholder file for future admin-related hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendActor.tsx: Context provider and hook managing backend actor initialization with retries, health checks, and identity handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of react-query hooks for profile, pickups, and report operations using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRadixOverlayCleanu: Hook that removes stale Radix scroll‑locking styles to fix frozen scrolling when dialogs are closed on Android Chrome.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, theme variables for light/dark modes, and Android Chrome compatibility overrides.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AccountSetupPage.tsx: Form page allowing users to view and update profile fields with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Empty placeholder file for an admin dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for an admin login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login screen using Internet Identity with theme toggling and UI components.
frontend/src/pages/LoginSelectionPage.ts: Empty placeholder file for a login selection page.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Main application layout with header, footer, pickup form, and daily pickup list.
frontend/src/utils/connectionDiagnostics: Provides functions to normalize connection errors and generate diagnostic messages.
frontend/src/utils/errorMessage.ts: Utilities for extracting, summarizing, and formatting error messages from unknown inputs.
frontend/src/utils/importNormalization.t: Normalizes legacy and modern import data formats into canonical pickup and customer structures.
frontend/src/utils/numberFormat.ts: Provides safe numeric formatting and parsing helpers that avoid crashes on invalid input.
frontend/src/utils/owedDriver.ts: Deprecated wrapper delegating owed-driver calculation to computeOwedDriver for consistency.
frontend/src/utils/pickupGuards.ts: Converts between bigint nanosecond timestamps and Date objects with Pacific-time formatting and day-grouping utilities.
frontend/src/utils/retryBackoff.ts: Implements an async retry utility with exponential backoff, jitter, and configurable options.
frontend/src/utils/totals.ts: Computes pickup totals, daily meter/tip aggregates, and the canonical owed-driver amount.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, layout, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Project state describing requirements, issues, and feature requests centered on applying the canonical Period Total formula and supporting optional voucher tips.
